results.name: determinism
results.detail: Same seed produced the same trace and terminal state.

results.name: ordinary resource capacity
results.detail: All ordinary resources remained uncapped and grew beyond the Food cap probe.

results.name: Food capacity
results.detail: Food stayed within its positive 10 cap under an overfill probe.

results.name: atomic research payment
results.detail: Unaffordable payment changed nothing; affordable payment deducted each cost once; activation blocks a second payment.

results.name: save state resume
results.detail: Restored state matches its save and resumed state/events match the uninterrupted run.

results.name: building geometric bulk cost
results.detail: Successive single costs increase and closed-form bulk cost covers the first two costs.

results.name: workshop/production chain
results.detail: Workshop purchase is single-shot and its ordered WoodLog-Plank-Alloy chain changes every stage output.

results.name: realtime/offline parity
results.detail: Realtime and offline produce identical states and event order; only the mode marker differs.

results.name: large ExpantaNum
results.detail: Large values remain finite through state addition and closed-form geometric cost.

results.name: era step schedule
results.detail: Parity defaults stay at Unity's fixed steps; explicit era-adaptive steps, transition boundaries, offline-session resets, and invalid inputs follow the contract.

results.name: trace first difference
results.detail: The first differing event reports index, tick, and field.

results.name: trace field exclusion
results.detail: Named fields can be excluded from parity comparison.

results.name: JSON/CSV/Markdown report contract
results.detail: All report formats contain snapshots, ordered events, first-difference tick/field, and the Unity/simulator fixture comparison.
